title: Migrate free-time data to new format (Oct 17)
text:
## Summary

The matching service v0.3 stores each student's weekly free time as 30-minute slots instead of free-text ranges. The old `availability` table can't hold the new format.

## Plan

- **When:** Saturday, October 17, 11 PM - 1 AM Eastern
- Take a full database backup first
- Run the migration script and check the row counts
- Show the "We'll be right back" screen in the app during the migration
- Rollback plan: restore the backup (about 15 minutes)

## Checklist

- [ ] Backup tested on staging
- [ ] Wop sends a notice to the Westbrook beta testers on Friday
- [ ] Tomas Rivera shares the notice in the campus group chat
- [ ] Migration done and verified

Owner: Daniel Ortiz
